grammar.title: 一般过去时：讲故事的基本时态
grammar.explanation: 小说和台本几乎都用过去时来讲故事。动词要变过去式：realize→realized, confess→confessed, arrange→arranged, admit→admitted。注意不规则变化：seize→seized（规则）, creep→crept, sweat→sweat。
examples: Ted realized he knew nothing about Stella.

Lily arranged a dinner for them.

grammar.title: too...to... 结构：太...而不能...
grammar.explanation: too + 形容词/副词 + to + 动词原形，表示「太...以至于不能...」。结构本身已有否定含义，不需再加 not。中考常考句型转换：too...to... ↔ so...that...can't。
examples: Ted was too distracted to react.
He was too nervous to speak clearly.

grammar.title: 宾语从句：动词后的 that 从句
grammar.explanation: 动词如 realize, confess, admit 后面常接 that 引导的宾语从句（that 可省略）。从句用陈述语序，不用疑问语序。高考重点考点。
examples: Ted realized that he knew nothing about Stella.
Barney admitted that he was trying.
She confessed that she was skeptical.

grammar.title: 祈使句：直接引语中的命令和建议
grammar.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，表示命令、请求或建议。否定形式是 Don't + 动词原形。口语高频结构。
examples: "Just ask me," Stella said.
"Don't cram the facts," she advised.
"Give him a chance," Lily urged.

grammar.title: 现在分词作伴随状语

Barney sat there, sweating through his shirt.
She smiled, holding his hand.

grammar.title: 过去完成时：had + 过去分词
grammar.explanation: 表示在过去某个时间之前已经完成的动作。常与 by the time, since, before 连用。小说中用来交代背景：Marshall 在八年前已经吃过那个汉堡。

grammar.title: 强调句：It was... that/who...
grammar.explanation: 强调句结构 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who...。可以强调主语、宾语或状语。中考常考句型转换。

grammar.title: 让步状语从句：though/although

examples: Though his voice was less enthusiastic, Barney liked it.

grammar.title: would rather... than...：宁愿...而不...
grammar.explanation: would rather + 动词原形 + than + 动词原形，表示「宁可...也不...」。注意两边的动词形式要一致。中考常考点。
examples: Ted would rather stay in New York than move to New Jersey.
Robin would rather leave than stay at a bad job.
I would rather walk than take the train.

grammar.title: 动词不定式作目的状语
grammar.explanation: to + 动词原形可以表示目的，意为「为了...」。可放在句首或句末。句首时常用逗号隔开。
examples: She wanted to pursue a better opportunity.
To raise a family, Stella chose New Jersey.
He went there to visit Stella.

grammar.title: 直接引语与间接引语转换
grammar.explanation: 直接引语变间接引语时，人称、时态、时间状语都要变化。一般现在时→一般过去时，now→then，today→that day。中考必考。
examples: Stella said, "New Jersey is great." → Stella said that New Jersey was great.
Robin said, "I have to do this." → Robin said that she had to do that.
Ted said, "You can't leave." → Ted said that she couldn't leave.

grammar.title: have to / must：不得不 vs 必须
grammar.explanation: have to 侧重客观需要（不得不），must 侧重主观必须。have to 有人称和时态变化，must 没有。否定形式含义不同：don't have to（不必）vs must not（禁止）。
examples: Robin had to leave for her career.
Ted must accept Stella's choice.
You don't have to like New Jersey.

grammar.title: 分词作状语：-ing 和 -ed 形式
grammar.explanation: 现在分词（-ing）表主动或状态，过去分词（-ed）表被动或感受。-ing 形容词修饰事物，-ed 形容词修饰人。
examples: Ted stood there, reluctantly admitting the truth.

The stalling career worried Robin.

grammar.title: 过去完成时 vs 一般过去时
grammar.explanation: 过去完成时（had + p.p.）表示「过去的过去」。一般过去时只表示过去发生的事。常在同一句中对比使用。
examples: They had never thrown a punch before that night.
Doug had punched them while they were unconscious.

grammar.title: 被动语态：be + 过去分词
grammar.explanation: 当动作的承受者是主语时用被动语态。常用于不知道或不关心谁做了动作的情况。
examples: They were shoved to the floor.
The story was exaggerated by Barney.
They were knocked out instantly.

grammar.title: should have done：本应该做...
grammar.explanation: should have + 过去分词表示对过去的虚拟，意为「本应该做但没做」。表批评或遗憾。否定：shouldn't have done。
examples: You should have seen us!
They shouldn't have pretended to be tough.
Barney should have admitted he was scared.

grammar.title: as...as...：和...一样...
grammar.explanation: as + 形容词/副词原级 + as，表示两者程度相同。否定形式 not as/so...as 表示「不如...」。
examples: They were as scared as each other.
Doug was not as tall as Barney.
The fight was as brief as a blink.

grammar.title: at least：至少
grammar.explanation: at least 表示「至少」，用于在不利情况中找到一点积极面。常放在句首或句中。
examples: At least we're honest cowards.
At least nobody got hurt.

grammar.title: 同位语从句：that 引导
grammar.explanation: 某些名词（fact, idea, news, truth）后跟 that 引导的同位语从句，解释该名词的具体内容。that 不省略。
examples: The fact that he lied hurt Robin.

grammar.title: not just...but (also)...：不仅...而且...
grammar.explanation: 连接两个并列成分，强调后者。also 可省略。注意前后结构要对称。
examples: Home was not just a place but the people.

The bar was not just warm but nostalgic.

grammar.title: 直接引语中的疑问句

examples: "Why would you lie?" → She asked why he would lie.

grammar.title: 动词不定式作定语

grammar.title: would 表示过去经常性动作

examples: They would resolve every argument physically.

grammar.title: too...to... 结构
grammar.explanation: too + 形容词/副词 + to + 动词原形，表示「太...以至于不能...」。已有否定含义，不加 not。
examples: The boundaries were too blurry to maintain.

examples: If he told her, she might reject him.

If the boundaries were clear, it would work.
